payload.title: Search and select editorial images through a shared service
payload.description:
As an editor or agent, I want to search image sources and choose a candidate so that I can illustrate a Story or Reference using the same Papyrus behavior from any client.

Feature: Shared image search and selection
  Scenario: Search a source in rounds of four
    Given an editor is preparing a Story or Reference
    When they search Wikimedia Commons with a topic or use a topic derived from the item
    Then Papyrus returns up to four candidates with stable identifiers, previews and available source and credit information
    And a later round can offer different candidates
  Scenario: Apply a selected candidate
    Given an authorized editor has selected an image candidate
    When they apply it to the item as a cover
    Then Papyrus saves the image and its provenance through the supported media workflow
    And the result can be replaced later without losing the item content
  Scenario: No suitable candidate
    Given no candidate is suitable
    When the editor declines the results
    Then no cover is applied and the existing placeholder remains available

Use a source adapter so other providers can be added. Honor site policy and existing UI behavior. Avoid a blanket assumption that one publication's fair-use policy applies to all publications.
